title: Origin story: Anubis
description: Anubis was the jackal-headed god who watched over the dead, son of Nephthys. When Osiris was murdered, Anubis invented mummification to preserve his body, and thereafter presided over every embalming. In the Hall of Two Truths he weighs each heart against the feather of Maat.

title: Ability profile: Anubis
description: Ranked abilities: Weighing of hearts — rank 100/100; Embalming craft — rank 100/100; Vigilance — rank 96/100; Protection — rank 95/100; Judgment — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Anubis
description: Powers: The scales of judgment — no heart can deceive them; Jackal-senses that find every tomb-robber; Mastery of preservation against decay itself.

title: Stamina feats: Anubis
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has weighed hearts since the first burials; Watches every cemetery without rest.

title: Crossover notes: Anubis
description: Anubis crosses naturally with: mummification, the dead, cemeteries, judgment.

title: Cultural impact: Anubis
description: The jackal remains the emblem of the funeral arts.

title: Generator record: Anubis
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Anubis's database.
